meta.note: v1 values extracted from Theme.swift and the views; v2 adds a dark theme, data hues, a spacing and size scale, and fixes the label contrast.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card (Theme.background in v1). One step darker than surface so cards read without shadows.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card fill: Home cards, Data rows, logged sets, rest timer (Theme.card in v1).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary pill buttons, the segmented switch track, search field, sheets. Replaces the literal Color.white in v1 views.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The 1 px card border (Theme.cardBorder in v1). Light: white on surface, a highlight rather than a line. Dark: a faint line. Never on the inverted card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and values on ground, surface and surface-raised (15.8:1 light, 16.9:1 dark). Also the weight trend line and steps marks.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, coverage text, sources, axis text on ground, surface and surface-raised (5.2:1 or better in both themes). Replaces v1's #8a8a8a, which was 3.0:1 on cards and failed AA.

tokens.name: invert
tokens.usage: The one 'do this now' surface per screen: the time-of-day Home card, the set logger, the Log and Connect buttons, the active nav circle.

tokens.name: on-invert
tokens.usage: Text and stepper outlines on invert.

tokens.name: on-invert-muted
tokens.usage: Labels on invert (7.2:1 light, 5.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines, empty coverage dots, the dashed outline of an absent bar. Decorative only: never the sole carrier of a value.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2 px focus ring, offset 2 px, on every focusable control. Solid ink, 15:1 on every surface it lands on; on invert it switches to ground.

tokens.name: camera
tokens.usage: Food camera background behind the preview, both themes.

tokens.name: on-camera
tokens.usage: Shutter ring and messages drawn directly on the camera. Always over camera-scrim, never bare over a photo.

tokens.name: camera-scrim
tokens.usage: Band behind the camera's today strip and messages, so white text holds 4.5:1 over a bright plate.

tokens.name: data-energy
tokens.usage: Food energy (kcal) marks and their legend text, everywhere. 5.2:1 on surface light, 7.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: data-energy-band
tokens.usage: The low to high band behind an energy midpoint. Never alone: the midpoint mark sits on it.

tokens.name: data-protein
tokens.usage: Protein (g) marks and legend text. Same lightness as data-energy, so the two are never overlaid in one plot: give each its own panel.

tokens.name: data-protein-band
tokens.usage: The low to high band behind a protein midpoint.

tokens.name: data-heart
tokens.usage: Heart rate and resting heart rate lines. A quantity, not an alarm: never used for errors or 'bad' days.

tokens.name: data-sample
tokens.usage: Raw samples under a derived line: weigh-in dots under the trend, single HRV readings. 3.7:1 light, 5.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: data-trend
tokens.usage: Any derived line (EWMA weight trend, 7-day means). Always ink, always 2 px.

tokens.name: sleep-deep
tokens.usage: Deep sleep segment, bottom row of the hypnogram.

tokens.name: sleep-core
tokens.usage: Core sleep segment.

tokens.name: sleep-rem
tokens.usage: REM segment. 2.7:1 on surface in light: the stage is carried by its row and label, not by this fill alone.

tokens.name: sleep-awake
tokens.usage: Awake segment, top row of the hypnogram; the one warm hue so wakeups stand out from the blues.

tokens.name: signal-error
tokens.usage: Text of a failed action ('Could not save the meal.', 'Not in Health'). Always a sentence, never a colour alone.

tokens.name: signal-pending
tokens.usage: Waiting states: 'Pending, will match when online', '+1 pending', unsynced records.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: t-hero
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the rest countdown. Tabular digits. Theme.heroNumberSize.

styles.name: t-big
styles.usage: The glance number on a Home card, the stepper values, the weight trend. Tabular digits. Theme.bigNumberSize and bigNumberTracking.

styles.name: t-stat
styles.usage: New. Secondary numbers on a detail screen: last night's sleep, a week's mean, a day total.

styles.name: t-title-1
styles.usage: Screen title under the Home button (AreaScaffold, metric detail). iOS Large Title.

styles.name: t-title-2
styles.usage: The exercise name on the set logger.

styles.name: t-headline
styles.usage: Row titles and every button label. iOS Headline.

styles.name: t-value
styles.usage: A row's value, right-aligned, tabular digits.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Ingest reads weight, steps and sleep to show your week.

styles.name: t-subtitle
styles.usage: Home card subtitles, logged set rows, search field. iOS Subheadline. Theme.subtitleSize.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Labels, coverage, sources, confidence reasons, in muted. Raised from v1's 11.5 px to iOS Caption 1 so it scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: t-axis
styles.usage: Chart axis and legend text only, in muted, tabular digits. iOS Caption 2.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Between a row title and its coverage label.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Inside a Home card between label, subtitle and value.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Between a chart and its legend; inside tag chips (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Between cards in a stack and between rows inside a card. The most used gap in v1.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Padding of the tall Home cards and the set logger: the two cards that carry a big number.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between the nav circles; between sections on a detail screen.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Above a section title on long detail screens.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card (Theme.cardRadius). Continuous corner style in SwiftUI.

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: A surface nested in a card: chart well, meal item row.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Tags (context, source, confidence).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, segmented switch, search field, toast. SwiftUI Capsule.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area of anything tappable, both axes. v1's row chevrons are 44 x 22 and miss it.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Stepper buttons, rest buttons, add-on pills, pill button minimum height is 50.

tokens.name: size-nav
tokens.usage: The three area circles (Theme.navCircleSize).

tokens.name: size-shutter
tokens.usage: The Food shutter ring.

tokens.name: size-spark
tokens.usage: Height of a row sparkline on the Data overview.

tokens.name: size-chart
tokens.usage: Height of a main chart on a metric detail screen.
